svg.title: VisionX technology stack
svg.desc: Updated original branded 1:3 technology inventory. Android Studio, Java/XML app and live stream/TTS are team-reported implemented. YOLOv8s is the temporary live mobile detection test model. Python, TensorFlow/Keras EfficientNetB0 and Streamlit belong to the implemented offline VXN-RAMNet core. VXN mobile integration is in progress; IMU fusion via Pi is planned. * Implemented hardware reflects the current team account. Cards identify technology roles, not processing order.
